profile.reading:
This building, SV5, is part of CoreSite's Santa Clara sub-campus at 2900 Stender Way, Santa Clara, CA 95054, per public property records; CoreSite does not currently publish a dedicated facility page or spec sheet for SV5, unlike SV1, SV4, SV7, SV8, and SV9, which do have live pages. SV5 is named as an existing campus building in a CoreSite press release about the broader Santa Clara campus, confirming it is a real, operating facility even without individual marketing content, so this entry does not assert an unconfirmed square footage or MW figure for it specifically.

CoreSite's Santa Clara sub-campus (SV3 through SV9) is described in a CoreSite construction-approval release as exceeding 775,000 square feet combined, part of a nine-building, 1.4-million-plus-square-foot Silicon Valley presence spanning San Jose, Santa Clara, and Milpitas. CoreSite is a subsidiary of American Tower Corporation (NYSE: AMT), which completed its acquisition of CoreSite in late 2021; Stonepeak Partners LP separately acquired roughly 29% of American Tower's US data center business in July 2022, later increased to about 36%. CoreSite's own site describes a total portfolio of 30 data centers across 11 US markets totaling more than 4.8 million square feet.

American Tower reported record leasing at CoreSite driving stronger-than-expected second-quarter 2026 results, projecting data-center segment revenue of $1.20 billion to $1.22 billion for full-year 2026, roughly 14.9% growth at the midpoint, and raising its full-year outlook on the strength of that performance; the company also budgeted approximately $695 million in data-center development spending for 2026, funding continued build-out including additional Santa Clara campus capacity beyond the currently marketed SV1/SV4/SV7/SV8/SV9 buildings.

reading.body:
CoreSite SV5 is a 101,430 square foot building on the nine-building Santa Clara campus that CoreSite owns in Silicon Valley. The operator does not publish power capacity for this specific building, and no figure appears in industry aggregators either. Without watts, the scale of its AI hosting potential cannot be assessed from published data.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities, of which 11 publish power capacity totaling 365 MW. CoreSite's Santa Clara campus as a whole ranks 12th by published capacity statewide, but the operator does not break down power by building within the campus, leaving SV5's contribution to that ranking unknown.

SV5 is one of three buildings on the campus that CoreSite names but does not detail individually on its regional page, making it invisible to the operator's own public specifications. Any assessment of whether this facility matters to AI infrastructure requires either the operator to publish its power capacity or independent measurement, neither of which is available in current sources.
